279628045.description:
You are purchasing a "Set of 3 Assorted Tobacco Pipes with Case" in "Used" condition.
untested Set of three classic tobacco pipes, perfect for collectors, display, or anyone who loves the look and ritual of traditional pipe smoking. This set includes: - One small white carved pipe with an ornate face design and a fitted, velvet-lined hard case. - One reddish-brown pipe with a textured, carved pattern around the bowl. - One dark brown bent pipe with a rounded bowl and metal band accent. Each pipe has character and visible use, giving them a warm, vintage feel that looks great on a shelf, in a study, or as part of a pipe collection. The white carved piece with its custom-fit case makes a nice standout display item or gift. Whether you’re a collector, a decorator, or just want a few classic pipes to complete a vintage look, this trio offers an attractive mix of styles in one convenient set. Keywords: tobacco pipe set, carved pipe, vintage style pipes, bent pipe, smoking pipe collection, decorative pipes, estate pipes, pipe with case measures approx. 6x5x1.5
Condition Notes:
Set of three tobacco pipes with visible signs of use. The white carved pipe with case appears lightly used, with clean white bowl and minor handling wear; its fitted black case shows light exterior scuffing and a clean interior lining. The reddish-brown pipe with carved pattern has noticeable surface wear and scratching on the bowl and some wear on the stem. The dark brown bent pipe has surface wear and finish loss on the bowl and visible wear and discoloration on the stem near the bit, with a metal band at the shank–stem junction that shows some dulling.

Color: Multicolor
